expectations.route: Second attempt uses invocation `ip -j route show` and sealed `call0002-stdout`; top-level dictionary records carry source report for destination/dev/gateway/type/protocol or other recognized routing fields, preserve unknown fields. Parsed datum `network.ip.local_routes.reported` (ARRAY). An empty JSON array is legitimate.
expectations.lineage: Bound attempt ID to precise subcall number, exact original byte hashes and slots, approved fixed argv, no source_paths nor target, no operator command injection. stderr diagnostic only; no stderr semantic parse.
expectations.states: Captured must have actual exit_code=0, no timeout, no capture limit, intact sealed original. Partial EXIT_NONZERO remains PARTIAL/SOURCE_INCOMPLETE, with exact exit and original bytes; parse failure from captured maps PARSE_FAILED.
expectations.negative: Swapped addr/route arrays, source command mismatch, cross-subcall artifact names, unapproved attempt 03, duplicated JSON keys, malformed nested arrays, NaN/Infinity, strings containing controls, oversize, forged targets/paths, evidence tamper, stderr-only capture, nonzero captured contradiction.
expectations.limits: Parser max 1MiB per sealed stdout vs 8MiB approved per-call; raw is preserved if parse cannot be completed. This does not prove network connectivity.
expectations.assurance: AI-written source-first oracle/tests are not independent human/third-party verification; no Bodhi target testing; owner gates open.
